name: Nexus-Updated
title: Nexus Extended Promethium Endgame (2.1)
author: Karu_Kiruna, updated by Alex Green
description:
Expands the Promethium Endgame and adds another planet with new production steps and ressources.
Nexus by Karu_Kiruna, updated for Factorio 2.1 until the original has a 2.1 release. Prototype and setting names are unchanged, so a save with Nexus can switch to this mod: install Nexus-Updated before you load it.
